data.name: Dayanidhi
data.gender_notes: Dayanidhi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dayanidhi is a Sanskrit name derived from two words - 'Daya' meaning divine grace and 'Nidhi' meaning wealth. This name signifies the divine grace that bestows wealth and prosperity upon an individual. The name Dayanidhi carries the meaning “God's wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dayanidhi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name bestowed by the gods, symbolizing divine blessings and prosperity.
data.etymology: Dayanidhi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dayanidhi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
